title: Repository backlog item
description: One schema-validated record under .devai/state/backlog/ written by the backlog action family (ADR-GOV-0019): a finding discovered during work that belongs to no round, a proposition for a later session, a note from one agent to another, or a flaky test observed under ADR-CHK-0001. An item carries its origin session, role, and commit so it outlives the session that made it. Round attribution is optional and is never inferred. A backlog item is not a round gap: it cannot pause, resolve, or otherwise alter one.

id.description: Stable repository-wide identifier allocated by backlog add and never reused.

class.description: Change class from the ADR-GOV-0017 taxonomy. Present when the item concerns a path; absent otherwise.

origin.description: Where the item came from. Recorded at creation and never edited.

session.description: Chain identity of the creating invocation: a validated authority session or the deterministic direct-cli chain, exactly as governance events record it.

commit.description: Exact HEAD commit of the working tree when the item was created.

round_id.description: Present only when the creator passed an explicit --round. Never inferred from the session, the branch, or the active round.

resolution.description: Reference that closes the item: a commit, a pull request, a decision record, a task id, or another backlog item. Present exactly when status is resolved.

resolved_at.description: Null while the item is open; set once by backlog resolve.
